result.keyword: What's the best CRM for a small team?
result.markdown:
For most small teams, I'd recommend **HubSpot CRM** as the best all-round starting point. However, if your team is primarily focused on sales, **Pipedrive** may actually be the better choice.

The best CRM depends on whether you need sales management, customer relationships, marketing automation or all three.

## My top 5 CRM recommendations

![21 Best CRM Enterprise Software Reviewed For 2026](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/E3oBllJko6DSkC1G-YxonkpSd-C9EJzphRnffFc13dKq176hHlHIBef_KD3uo3Rj4h1fcldcCQ6woqfNfkWWmNW8Rs1_qiHKjMrnT7yrtNAkkpWII-RvqcBN_-0EERClJKgsbj3AQum9lvjpnXVV_ofvoY4dYvM4uvHF3Aza7RJS9SAW_-O73lSaxuQ1_7Sl?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. HubSpot CRM**

(Best overall)

- Excellent free starting plan
- Contact management and sales pipelines
- Email tracking and marketing tools
- Easy for a small team to adopt

**Best for\:** Businesses wanting sales, marketing and customer management together.

[HubSpot website](https://www.hubspot.com/products/crm)

---

![Pipedrive Culture | Comparably](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/LL0qs5ZEn5bajHXZMpCmlJ4Q8G8bG-uCRPdMDaugOTZ5M83xr5SdfSJtpaTsU9pV5XZU_j6tdK98aLeb5eQtmf3jAulEyqWXtwu_NCqqantmt4RgTKgW92e5jqAqiwI5Gvz6HoJSFRLf0DV2WCKF0F5we1qdhyYgERFOvFPWSwO__wWT47lukE3R9cSOeuBr?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Pipedrive**

(Best for sales teams)

- Excellent visual sales pipeline
- Tracks leads, deals and follow-ups
- Easy to understand
- Great sales activity reporting

**Best for\:** Teams managing enquiries, prospects, quotes and sales opportunities.

[Pipedrive website](https://www.pipedrive.com/)

---

![TheProwess | Zoho CRM'de Yeni Dönem: Eski Arayüz 15 Temmuz'da Tamamen Kaldırılıyor](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/mhOzD_IXTeMyjegHs7_31H-nZlvGoIQWY2PfiTmHpwuQOA09A9NutmTAM8TWT2HF-7JryptkgV-lS_xHcaI7d43ujbBUTvqfxj-z3nk-gdRQr3-Ei-qigHIPik-T14ytWC4EuYLl0he93dU9qCw5sHTS1LPdprZuUjTWv0UHX5wzcmxSTdtKBrPPwq-xdGBE?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Zoho CRM**

(Best value)

- Strong automation capabilities
- Customisable workflows
- Good reporting and analytics
- Free plan for up to three users

**Best for\:** Small businesses wanting flexibility without expensive subscriptions.

[Zoho CRM website](https://www.zoho.com/crm/)

---

![Descargar Freshsales CRM varies-with-device para Web Apps - Filehippo.com](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ymGWkXtkAC7MoWysGML3OKgHF9O0MPKH1PfAAeDjk1aaZrRWaVBb9r5y-Kf_8j4xYqKU0KB7QvzLaYT0HE0Vv7VVhtrsyXiqQzkmNrQWCEXFxliHIByLJsgnf2ztG74VQ6KpL_qyhXQE--CUkaD3WIbFGDInuBn5hMKNEjmTwahJ5xR1Qf4y9c43huoiOovk?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Freshsales**

- Built-in phone and communication tools
- Sales automation
- Lead scoring
- Useful AI features

**Best for\:** Teams handling lots of incoming enquiries and customer conversations.

[Freshsales website](https://www.freshworks.com/crm/sales/)

---

![monday.com Products | Boost Productivity Today — Elevate Operations](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/9pbfxtp9MRSzmGqOOXUT3zYq1fPIuocDylKAQoIzVyuW1Vjc44XoGiROM2GBYduUngwZNPfMFXzqdnmJ1poftmoV-bK85Cp0YYpYmV5sjFjpnjYHjyVWJd9MpDQXQDk0zHwEfS7B57VsWkUtP1cpZQ-ZPXVz1YthngyreHroaIgVKVfnbNj-IFVycI5aW_GQ?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. monday CRM**

- Visual and customisable dashboards
- Sales and project management
- Team collaboration
- Workflow automation

**Best for\:** Teams wanting CRM and internal work management in one place.

[monday CRM website](https://monday.com/crm)

## Quick comparison

| CRM | Main strength | Starting option |
|--------|--------|--------|
| HubSpot | All-round CRM | Free |
| Pipedrive | Sales pipeline | From A\$19/user/mo |
| Zoho | Value and flexibility | Free / A\$22 paid |
| Freshsales | Sales communication | From A\$15/user/mo |
| monday CRM | Team workflows | From A\$19/seat/mo |
